text:
Picture a plumber in Midland. He spends three months choosing a new logo.

In the same three months, the plumber down the road asks every customer for a Google review.

Google's map counts your reviews. Nobody picks a plumber for his logo.

Ask for reviews this week. The logo can wait.

You can't move your shop closer to every customer.

Google's map favours businesses near the person searching. So a sparky in Fremantle has a hard time showing up for searches in Ellenbrook.

Own the suburbs around you first. Then spread out.

Anyone can suggest an edit to your Google Business Profile. New hours. A new phone number.

Google gives you four days to reject it. After that, Google can publish it without asking you.

Log in once a week. Check your hours and phone number are still right.
